from pathlib import Path

INK='#162e3a'

BLUE='#15647c'
BLEND='#34344e'
PAPER='#fffdf8'
CREAM='#f3e7ce'
TINT='#edf3f1'
LINE='#a8b9b8'
WHITE='#ffffff'
COND='DIN Condensed'
BODY='Helvetica Neue'
MONO='Menlo'

def rect(x,y,w,h,fill='none',stroke='none',sw=1,extra=''):
    return f'<rect x=\"{x}\" y=\"{y}\" width=\"{w}\" height=\"{h}\" fill=\"{fill}\" stroke=\"{stroke}\" stroke-width=\"{sw}\" {extra}/>'
def line(x,y,x2,y2,color=LINE,sw=1,extra=''):
    return f'<path d=\"M{x} {y}H{x2}\" stroke=\"{color}\" stroke-width=\"{sw}\" {extra}/>' if y==y2 else f'<path d=\"M{x} {y}L{x2} {y2}\" stroke=\"{color}\" stroke-width=\"{sw}\" {extra}/>'
def path(d, fill, extra=''):
    return f'<path d=\"{d}\" fill=\"{fill}\" {extra}/>'
def circle(x,y,r,c):
    return f'<circle cx=\"{x}\" cy=\"{y}\" r=\"{r}\" fill=\"{c}\"/>'
def txt(x,y,s,size=22,color=INK,bold=False,font=BODY,anchor='start',spacing=0):
    return f'<text x=\"{x}\" y=\"{y}\" font-family=\"{font}\" font-size=\"{size}\" font-weight=\"{700 if bold else 400}\" fill=\"{color}\" text-anchor=\"{anchor}\" letter-spacing=\"{spacing}\">{escape(s)}</text>'
def lines(x,y,seq,size=22,leading=31,color=INK,bold=False):
    return ''.join(txt(x,y+i*leading,s,size,color,bold) for i,s in enumerate(seq))
def tag(x,y,s,c=BLUE,size=14):
    return txt(x,y,s,size,c,True,MONO,spacing=1.1)
def head(x,y,s,size=75,c=INK):
    return txt(x,y,s,size,c,True,COND)
def group(content,x=0,y=0,s=1,extra=''):
    return f'<g transform=\"translate({x} {y}) scale({s})\" {extra}>{content}</g>'
def svg(content,w,h):
    return f'<svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"{w/72}in\" height=\"{h/72}in\" viewBox=\"0 0 {w} {h}\">{content}</svg>'
def arrow(x,y,c=BLUE):
    return path(f'M{x} {y}h24v-5l10 7-10 7v-5h-24Z',c)
def footer(num):
    return line(48,549,1176,549)+tag(48,574,'PRINT SHOP OPEN HOUSE')+txt(1176,574,num,14,BLUE,True,MONO,'end',1)
def board(kicker,title,deck):

def chip(x,y,n,text):

    'M38 251 C94 252 130 268 173 280 C222 293 261 281 304 258 L304 278 C259 304 218 313 169 300 C122 287 86 275 38 275 Z',
]
WD=' '.join(WAVES)
def motif(mode, uid, a=ORANGE,b=BLUE):
    clip=f'<defs><clipPath id=\"sun{uid}\">{circle(173,135,105,\"white\")}</clipPath><clipPath id=\"no{uid}\">{path(\"M-4 -4H350V321H-4Z \"+WD,\"white\", \"clip-rule=\\\"evenodd\\\"\")}</clipPath></defs>'
    sun=circle(173,135,105,a)
    wave=path(WD,b)
    if mode=='a': return sun
    if mode=='b': return wave
    if mode=='ka': return clip+f'<g clip-path=\"url(#no{uid})\">{sun}</g>'
    if mode=='k': return sun+wave
    if mode=='o': return clip+sun+wave+path(WD,BLEND,f'clip-path=\"url(#sun{uid})\"')
    raise ValueError(mode)

def output(filename,docs):
    with TemporaryDirectory(prefix='tidal-print-') as work:
        work=Path(work)
        pages=[]
        for i,doc in enumerate(docs):
            source=work/f'{i}.svg'
            dest=work/f'{i}.pdf'
            source.write_text(doc)
            run(['rsvg-convert','--format=pdf','--output',dest,source],check=True)
            pages.append(dest)
        run(['pdfunite',*pages,ROOT/filename],check=True)

An open house built around *Tidal Signal*, a fictional poster. Visitors handle three stocks, compare four ink pulls, then choose among three finished prints. Send up to six visitors to Paper every 15 minutes. Each group follows the same route in about 26 minutes.

## Set up and print

Start with the [staff guide](<04 Staff/Staff guide.pdf>) for the floor layout, staff assignments, sample schedule, and press instructions.

| [Poster plates](<03 Poster artwork/Poster plates.pdf>) | Three aligned 11 × 17 in portrait plates for the finished posters. |
| [Swatch plates](<03 Poster artwork/Swatch plates.pdf>) | Three aligned Letter landscape plates for four swatches per sheet. |
| [Poster color proofs](<03 Poster artwork/Poster color proofs.pdf>) | Page 1 is the overprint for A on smooth white and B on natural stock. Page 2 is the knockout for C on the same stock as A. |
| [Swatch color proofs](<03 Poster artwork/Swatch color proofs.pdf>) | Pages 1–4 show Ink A only, Ink B only, overprint, and knockout. Use page 3 on all three stocks for the Paper station if working from these proofs. |

For two-ink printing, each plate file uses the same page order. Page 1 is orange for overprint, page 2 is blue for both versions, and page 3 is orange for knockout. Print the appropriate orange plate first, then the blue. The colored PDFs simulate the crossing and can also be used on a composite printer. If you use them for display, tell visitors they are printed simulations and that actual ink interactions vary with the press and stock.
